description: This file serves as an initializer for the 'ml_services' package, providing a lightweight interface for multiple ML models including sentence embeddings, NLI entailment checking, and NER, and listing the primary services available within the package.

classes.name: EmbeddingService
classes.description: Provides methods for generating sentence embeddings using the all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model.

classes.name: NLIService
classes.description: Provides Natural Language Inference entailment checking using the DeBERTa-MNLI model.

classes.name: NERService
classes.description: Provides Named Entity Recognition capabilities using the BERT-NER model.
